name: soul-dublers
description: Sistema de cadastro e classificação de dubladores da comunidade Soul Dublers

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/bot
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
